rating.comments: Student messages give mostly bare answers, such as "25" and "the weather", with little stated reasoning, though "the students go to school 5 days per week and they consume 5 litres per day" restates the given facts. Knowledge building is 3 because "25" applies the earlier 5 litres and 5 days to the calculation. No question about the content was asked, so question_asking is 0. Effort is 4 because the student made several task-focused calculation attempts ("20 00 fois 5", "100 000", "25") and kept trying after repeated prompts, though two replies were just "no".
